decision.observation: Deselected; 'UNIT NEEDS ORDERS' persists; turn still 2; Eagle Warrior at ~0.50,0.30. Every map click deselects and never moves. The unit appears to be on the city's northern tile abutting the lake; the golden wheat tile is actually WEST/northwest, and to the southeast is lake. It's genuinely boxed.
decision.hypothesis: Across many attempts, clicking map or action buttons always deselects without moving or fortifying. This strongly implies the unit has no legal moves and clicks are being swallowed. The most plausible real end-turn control: press Return while NO unit is selected may end turn. Or perhaps the game auto-advances and the '2' is a stuck readout. The one control I haven't tried cleanly: the '!' button in Civ VI actually is the 'End Turn' button. When units need orders it shows '!' but clicking it when the currently-needing-orders unit is ALREADY selected should end the turn. Let me select the unit AND then without deselecting press '!' — but '!' reselects. Let me instead press the Return key now (unit not selected) to end turn.
decision.memory: Map/button clicks always deselect. Try Return key to end turn with nothing selected.
